name: 50.1 — WDFOX TEST RAG Lookup and Quote v1

parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT jsonb_build_object('service_code',service_code,'title',title,'scope',description,'unit_price_cents',unit_price_cents,'currency',currency,'minimum_order_cents',minimum_order_cents,'tax_mode',tax_mode,'pricebook_version',pricebook_version,'indexed_at',indexed_at) FROM wdfox_test.pricebook_items WHERE service_code=$1 AND pricebook_version=$2 AND environment='TEST' AND indexed_at IS NOT NULL) AS price_item;

parameters.content:
## 50.1 — RAG lookup and canonical-price TEST
Manual trigger only, no public webhook. PostgreSQL is read-only in this workflow.
Select OpenAI credential on Embed Request and PostgreSQL credential on Read Canonical Price (same as 50.0). If Qdrant uses an API key, configure api-key HTTP Header credential on Search TEST Pricebook.
Test Request contains ONE explicit service scope and quantity; this is not a multi-service autonomous planner. Expected NAV-01 / 45.00 EUR excl. VAT if retrieval confidence passes. Score gates are heuristic, not proof of scope compliance. Low/ambiguous matches return NEEDS_CLARIFICATION, never an invented price. DEV-01 always requests an estimate.
Tax is unconfigured; payable total stays null. No invoice, payment, deployment, or customer approval. Do not publish. API embeddings incur usage costs.
